name: io.github.GeiserX/spinnaker-mcp
title: Spinnaker
description: MCP server exposing Spinnaker CD platform via Gate API for pipeline and deployment management

environmentVariables.name: GATE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Spinnaker Gate API URL (e.g. https://spin-gate.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: GATE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for Gate

environmentVariables.name: GATE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth username (alternative to a token)

environmentVariables.name: GATE_PASS
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth password

environmentVariables.name: GATE_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: SESSION cookie of a Gate behind SSO (OAuth2, SAML); or run 'spinnaker-mcp login' once

environmentVariables.name: GATE_COOKIE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding that SESSION cookie (default: the file 'spinnaker-mcp login' writes)

environmentVariables.name: GATE_CERT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: x509 client certificate (PEM); needs GATE_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.name: GATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: x509 client key (PEM); needs GATE_CERT_FILE

environmentVariables.name: GATE_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification of Gate (testing only)

environmentVariables.name: TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to register. Default readonly; 'all' also registers the tools that trigger, cancel, edit, delete and judge pipelines
